title: Two-word sweeper 1RB---_1LC0RF_0RA0LD_1LE1LA_1RF0LF_0LC0RA: 1,500 overflows of R, no halt
text: Applying the layer law in closed form between overflows, and running only each overflow event on the machine, follows 1,500 overflows of the last word R, to about 10<sup>874</sup> events, with no halt. Every overflow eats d low base-3 digits of N and the next event has N' = ⌊N / 3<sup>d</sup>⌋ + 1 (d is never 1). The exact law for d and the new words is open.
